title: Russell's birth in Canton, Missouri
summary: Russell gives his birth date, 1905, and his small Mississippi river hometown with little music; the transcript then collapses into a repeated-word ASR loop.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: This is Bill Russell. I'll start in a little bit with my life since they wanted to know a few of the early facts. I was born 1905, February the 26th, in a small town up on the Mississippi, Canton, Missouri, about 150 miles north of St. Louis. There was little music in the town, although I remember as early as I can remember hearing different orchestras.
